entry.title: New: Resolution 537 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR A MULTI-YEAR LEASE OF REAL PROPERTY FOR THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI IN KEAʻAU, DISTRICT OF PUNA

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement with an option to extend for two additional five-year terms with Milo Storage, LLC, for approximately 800 square feet of warehouse space.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 537-24 & FC-168 - 07/10/24
